name: OmaEcosystem
author: arbabmujtaba
description: Your Android phone as part of the desktop: one click docks its live, controllable screen on the right (scrcpy over USB or wireless ADB), with clipboard both ways, file sending, phone screenshots, link handoff, notifications and one-click hotspot. Keeps wireless ADB ready in the background.

barWidget.description: Phone icon in the bar; click to dock your phone's screen on the right.

schema.label: Screen size (inches)
schema.description: Diagonal of the mirrored screen at real size. Shrinks automatically if it doesn't fit.

schema.label: Make room for the dock
schema.description: Tile windows beside the dock instead of letting it float above them.

schema.label: Turn the phone's own screen off
schema.description: The phone keeps running but its display stays dark while docked.

schema.label: Keep wireless mirroring ready
schema.description: In the background, reconnect wireless ADB and switch a plugged-in phone to wireless so you can unplug it.

schema.label: Phone Bluetooth address
schema.description: Optional. Found automatically when the phone is paired under the same name it shows over ADB.

schema.label: Phone hotspot name
schema.description: Optional. Learned from the phone when it is docked. A saved Wi-Fi connection name or the hotspot's SSID.
